intent: Publish a content site with articles and a newsletter signup, targeted at indie builders.
notes: Product surface with an audience and a conversion goal; gold at sentence granularity.

known_facts.statement: A content site should publish articles to an audience.
A newsletter signup captures readers on the site.
The target audience is indie builders.

assumptions.statement: A newsletter provider is available to handle subscriptions.

options.statement: Use a static site generator to publish the content.

decisions.statement: Target indie builders as the primary audience.

open_questions.statement: Clarify the hosting provider and domain to use.
